info.description:
### eCrop API based on **AgroConnect eCrop standard version 0.4** 

This API concerns registration of crop related activities like application of crop protection products and fertilizers and energy and water consumption.

This API is based on the [Agroconnect eCrop class model version 0.4](https://www.agroconnect.nl/Portals/10/EnterpriseArchitect/eCrop_json/eCrop_v0_4/index.html).

Applied standards:
- [API Design Rules version 2.0.2](https://gitdocumentatie.logius.nl/publicatie/api/adr/) of the NL API Strategie (Dutch API Strategy)
- RFC 9457: Problem Details for HTTP APIs (Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF))
- Sematic versioning using Semver

Design decisions
- super/subtypes (UML generalisations): subtypes are allOf with $ref to supertype and object with subtype atributes
- UML compositions: hierachy in URI (should be aggegrations in eCrop class model) or array in master-object

Remarks on class model
- Renamed "cytyName" in Address to "cityName"
- "Compositions" should be renamed to "Components"
- change applicable composition-relations to aggegration-relations 
- Rename "Farm" to "Location" (or ay least confirm Farm == Location)??
- Add relation grower-to-farm to support get/post locations per grower?
- Relation delivery should link to "grower" iso "receiver"
- attributes "id" and "name" in "greenhouselocation" are prefixed with class name
- changed all class names to CamelCase (ADR: schemanames must be CamelCase)
- changed IBAN to iban (ADR: properties must be lowerCamelCase) 

Copyright (c)  AgroConnect 2025

Version.description: Version of the API based on semver notation

ProblemDetails.description: Problem details based on the "[Problem Details for HTTP APIs" specification, RFC 9457](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9457).

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

MeasurementType.title: MeasurementType
MeasurementType.description: Standard data type for expressing the value of a measurement. To be used for all types of measurement in this class model.

value.description: Expresses the measured value of the measurement.

unitcode.description:
The code that refers to the standard unit or dimension to express the value of this measurement. E.g. KGM for kilogram.
Code list Id: nl.cl020

CharacteristicType.title: CharacteristicType
CharacteristicType.description: Generic data type for linked characteristics to a crop, task, operation, allocation, etc.

codelistid.description:
Identifier of the code list that contains the coding of characteristics for a specific domain:

For instance:
The code list id for crop and operations characteristics for arable farming is NL_CL265.

issuedate.description: The data the characteristic was captured.

startdate.description: Begin data of the period this characteristic is or was valid.

enddate.description: End data of the period this characteristic is or was valid.

id.description: Represents the value of the Identifier; e.g. the gln number.

PartyIdTypeCodeType.title: PartyIdTypeCodeType
PartyIdTypeCodeType.description: Code list for the type of scheme that is used for the type of Identifier (e.g. a gln, or chamber of commerce number). For this, code list CL709 is used.

Party.title: Party
Party.description: Data about the Party that is involved in producing or processing the crop and or agricultural produce.

Grower.description: The grower (e.g. the farmer) that is responsible for the cultivation of the crop.

Farm.description: The entity that is responsible for cultivation the crops.

Asset.title: asset
Asset.description:
Entity of a tangible object on which operations can be performed.
E.g.: a crop, a building, a machine, a ditch, a greenhouse, a climate control system, a feeding system, etc.

Crop.title: crop
Crop.description: The cultivation of a specific crop type (e.g. potato, wheat, rice,. etc.) on one or more plots during a specific period of time, specified by startDateTime and endDateTime.

year.description: Indication of the year in which the cultivation is harvested.

region.description: Region of a country the cultivation took place.\nFor eCrop in The Netherlands for this code list code list NL.CL044 is used.

trackTillage.description:
Indicates whether the cultivation, over the years, is done in fixed lanes with fixed tracks for machinery.

yes = track tillage is applied
no = track tillage is not applied

PlantSpecies.title: plantspecies
PlantSpecies.description:
Crop type at the level of potato, sugar beet, onion, winter wheat, etc.
For mixed crops more then one type of crop can be grown in the same period at the same plot.

Plot.title: plot
Plot.description:
Surface (area) that is used to grow plants.
The exact location of this surface is specified by either, a greenhouse-location a point location or a border location (using outer and inner polygons).

regularOrOrganic.description:
Indicates whether this plot is classified for organic production or not.
Production protocol: indicates whether this plot is classified  for organic production or not.
Code list:NL_CL015

localSoilType.description:
Code for the soil type, as used for a specific use case.
LocalSoilType code consists of the reference to the code list that is being used plus the code from this code list.
For eCrop in arable farming in The Netherlands, code list nl.cl405 is used

regulatorySoilType.description:
Code for the soil type, as subscribed by a regulatory authority (e.g. MLNV-RVO in the Netherlands).
For eCrop in The Netherlands code list nl.cl405 is used.

blockId.description: Identifier of a block (in Dutch: afdeling) within the greenhouse.

postId.description: Identifier of a post (in Dutch: paal) within the block of the greenhouse

upToPostId.description:
Identifier of a second post (in Dutch: paal) within the block of the greenhouse.
The upToPost can be used to refer to the location between two posts (postId and upToPostId).

waterTapId.description: Identifier of a watertap (in Dutch: waterpunt) within a greenhouse.

hortivationpointBlock.description: Coordinates of the standard Hortivation location reference point for the block

xyzReferenceToHotivationPoint.description: The xyz-position to the standard Hortivationpoint of this block within a greenhouse

Task.title: task
Task.description:
A Task is the execution of one or more Operation's by a ma-machine-system.
A 'task' consists of one ore more 'operations' that are closely related but involve different assents and resources. All combined operations need to be carried out well coordinated, to execute the task.
For instance, the task potato harvesting involves: one tractor pulling the potato harvester, 2 units to take care of the transport of the harvested potatoes to the barn, equipment at the barn to unload the transport units and to bring the produce in the storing place.

id.description: The Identifier of the task assigned by the originator of the Task.

referenceId.description: The Identifier of the ordered task that resulted in this executed task.

Operation.title: operation
Operation.description:
Activity carried out by man and/or machine as part op the execution of a task.
An operation performs a particular OperationTechnique on a particular asset (a crop,a field, a production unit, a batch, etc.) to realize a certain Cultural Practice or Husbandry Practice.
Examples for CropProduction:
The CulturalPractise "weed control"can be realized by one of various OperationTechnique's like spraying, row cultivation, manual hoeing, etc.

id.description: The Identifier of the operation assigned by the originator of the operation.

thirdPartyId.description: Identifier of this operation, allocated by a third Party.

characteristics.description: The option to attach one or more characteristics about the execution of this operation.

refereanceId.description: The Identifier of the ordered operation that resulted in this executed operation.

Allocation.title: allocation
Allocation.description: The generic class (the parent) for input and output allocation.

InputAllocation.title: inputallocation
InputAllocation.description:
One or more inputs used to execute this operation.
Examples of types of input are: crop protection products, fertilizer, water, energy, labor, etc.

OutputAllocation.title: outputallocation
OutputAllocation.description:
One or more outputs as the result of the execution of the operation.
For example harvested produce: potatoes, onions, flowers, vegetables, etc..
But an output could also be for instance energy.

ProcessState.title: ProcessState
ProcessState.description: To specify the status of execution (proposed, planned, executed) of a task or operation.

code.description: Specific code from the code list that is referred to by codeListId.

codeListid.description:
Identifier of the standard code list that contains the allowed codes.
The naming convention for the reference to a standard code list is: “nl.cl<nnn>” (e.g. “nl.cl232”).
Where "nl" stands for the 2 character country code, "cl" stands for code list and <nnn> stands for the 3 character Identifier of the specific code list within the scope of the specified country.

issueingPartyId.description: The organization that is responsible for issuing and maintaining the standard code list

uri.description: Url where the standard code list is to be found.

PlotType.title: plottype
PlotType.description: The type of production surface to grow plants. Can be a crop field for arable farming or a moving table (platform) for potted plants in floriculture.

Date.title: date
Date.description: Default date format with ISO-8601 standard date format "yyyy-mm-dd"

DateTime.title: datetime
DateTime.description: Default datetime format with ISO-8601 standard date format "yyyy-mm-ddThh24:mm:ss+hh:mm"

Delivery.title: delivery
Delivery.description:
Delivery by the farm of a harvested batch of produce to a buyer.
Or, materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. A
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a buyer through an order to
a seller.

default_error.description:
Standard error response based on the "[Problem Details for HTTP APIs" specification, RFC 9457](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9457). 

*Remark: Content-type should be application/problem+json (not application/json)*

User-Agent.name: User-Agent
User-Agent.description: Make, brand and version of the calling client software
